rules.message: Every chooser checkbox shares name="cols" — Apply must serialize repeated cols= params.
Choosing columns is idempotent navigation — the chooser form GETs the grid URL (data-hx-get), never posts.
The chooser must declare where the grid lives: data-hx-target on the form.
data-hx-target must resolve to the grid element the server re-renders.
Target the datagrid wrapper by id (e.g. #items-grid) — the server re-renders the whole grid (header + rows), not just a tbody.
Keep action + method="get" on the chooser so Apply works without JavaScript.
